chapters: Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bɨɨx dɨr vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu vaakax gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu jodai' gu chio'ñ cham gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' aagak gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tasi' tuur gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu bhóogɨt gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' xikoolh bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jugi gu u'u bhaan gu tai.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mo'o gu tanoolh bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan ka't kakneer kaneer gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx mo'o gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' bhaan gu u'u bhaan gu tai gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' ba'k gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt bɨx jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' maa'nkar tai bhaan ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu u'uvhig jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' jix duñia' mo'o jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu suudai' bhaan gu maa'nkar jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan tas buusñi pai' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu' cham gu ñi'ook gook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu u'u jix duñia' gu tai; mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' gu o'o gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar ka't gu chuukug gu vaak bhaan mi'x juu'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan kubhion.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhuup gu chuukug gu vaak bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx bɨx kubhion jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu o'o ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gu o'o gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' gu chuukug gu vaak cham jabka' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu o'o ka't gu maa'nkar gu suudai' ka't gu chuukug gu vaak cham jabka' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' gu o'o.
Jano' ba' tu' gu o'o ka't gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug gu vaak bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar jix duñia' dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mii' dhɨr gu o'o chɨ'ñchoka' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu o'o ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jabka'; na gu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' tu' matgɨm gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' bɨx gu maa'nkar gu o'o bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham jix duu jix duñia' mɨɨjidha' gu o'o gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu o'o gu ux na tu ibai' gu oi'ñga'n gu tai kaipgaidhat gu ñi'ook kai'ñ jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan kubhion; gio ba' gu o'o.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n chɨ'ñchoka' gu duukam baasɨ'n kai'ñ jix duñia' bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx bɨx kubhion; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu maa'nkar ka't gu maa'nkar gu chuukug tu' ka't jix duñia' gu vaakax gu chuukug ka't gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu maa'nkar gu tasi' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu jodai' bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duu gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu u'u gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim gu tai; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' kakneer ka't gu maa'nkar na ba' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' mar kaneer gu ux gu maa'nkar tu' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu maa'nkar mi' dhɨr gu tasi' vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' tatk gu tasi' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu jodai' bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu kutun gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu tasi' vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu jodai' bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu kutun gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨx jix koi gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tu' matgɨm gu ɨ'ɨr jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'x cham jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook bhaan uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ux uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jugi tuur cham gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tuur ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o tuur gu tasi' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu bhóogɨt vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia' xidhuu.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tuur tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tuur na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu jodai' bhaan ba'k.
Jano' ba' gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu vaakax gu maa'nkar gu chuukug; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tuur bɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx mo'o gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx tuur jix duñia' mai' yooxi' pai' na jix bhai' pai' mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu tai bhaan gu u'u; gio ba' pai' mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' tu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu takarui' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu vupui gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia' ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ bhaan jix duñia' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tuur gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' daraa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' mii' dhɨr tuur.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' kɨɨv mui'kim vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' mii' dhɨr tuur na ja'p bɨɨx tuur gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tuur mai' vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu ñi'ook maa'n tuur; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu vaak gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tasi' uañi'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux gu maa'nkar gu chio'ñ chiiw cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tasi' pai' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook kua'dam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu'x cham jix duñia' duñia' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tasi' uañi'ñ jugi gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar gu u'vɨ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n cham gu jodai' gu ux uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jugi.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' pai' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai' ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ux ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook mar kaneer na ba' gu maa'nkar gu ux uañi'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ bhaan mo'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu jodai' na ja'p ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jugi ka't gu chuukug.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook ka't naak gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu tasi' jix ñi' gu bhóogɨt tu' cham gu suudai' jix duñia' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ka't dhaa no'x gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't gu chuukug jix koi gu vaakax gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug jix koi gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi' gu chuukug jix koi gu ko'oi ñaanbi' xoi'kam cham gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ ñaanbi' no'x gu vaak gu jodai' ñaanbi' cham mi'x juu'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' mi' dhɨr gu takarui' maachim ka't jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu'x gu chio'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' mi' dhɨr gu chuukug ka't gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x jix duñia' mii' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ux uañi'ñ tu' jugi gu u'vɨ kakneer ali' karneer gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt na ba' mar kaneer gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux uañi'ñ jugi gook gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' maa'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt maa'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt mo'o baakux gu' cham jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu maa'nkar jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr gu takarui' tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jugi ka't gu chuukug.

Gu' gu' tu' jix duñia' cham gu bhóogɨt na ba' gook gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa gu chuukug gu vaak gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' bhaan gu bhóogɨt kubhion na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jix bhuup chɨ'ñchoka' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ux uañi'ñ jugi gu ñi'ook dhi' tu'x ka't gu chuukug; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu o'o gu kutun.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jugi uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n kakneer jurtu'nka' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu bhóogɨt xidhuu gu maa'nkar gu ux uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ka't uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ jixchamaam maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu ux uañi'ñ ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr tu'x gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' duñia' gu suudai' cham duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n kakneer; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak jugi gu ux gu takarui' ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tɨtmo gu oi'ñga'n tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu novɨ xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨɨxi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mii' dhɨr tu'x gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ux gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu takarui' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' baasɨ'n tu' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu suudai' gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu tasi' no'x gu bhóogɨt tu'x gu takarui' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga maa'nkar tai bhaan; na gu' maa'nkar tai bhaan na gu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx gu tukaa' bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n; jano' ba'.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bhaan gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu tai ka't gu oi'ñga'n maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr cham kutun gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n mai' vaak ja'tkam pai' na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan cham tu' tanaarada' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu xibh jix duñia' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tai tu' xib ja'k tɨkɨr jix bhai'x jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu o'o; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu chuukug gu vaak gu o'o bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨx kubhion bhaan gu o'o jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ux chɨ'ñchoka' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ jugi gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' cham jabka' gu ñi'ook pai' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jugi.

Jano' ba' cham gu takarui' bɨɨx jabka'; gio ba' gu takarui' jix maa gu ux gu maa'nkar maa'nkar na jix maa gu tai; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux uañi'ñ na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jugi; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug ka't na ba' gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar na jix maa gu tai gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh ka't maa'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Epa gu chuukug gu vaak gu o'o gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' bapaalh gu jodai' gu o'o gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu Aaroon ka't maa'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨx ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu o'o jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' cham jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr pai' ka't gu takarui' maa'nkar tai bhaan ka't gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ux uañi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' gu ux gu ñi'ook jugi; gio ba' pai' jix bhaan ka't jugi gu i'ii'ñ vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug gu suudai' ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan tɨi'chu' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr bhaan jix duñia' pai' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ ka't gu chuukug ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam ka't gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jugi; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' cham jugi gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu suudai' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' pai' gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tasi' gu chuukug gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gook gu chuukug gu jodai' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bɨɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh bhaan gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jugi; gio ba' ka't jugi pai' jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu ux uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu jodai' ka't na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu o'o gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu o'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jix gaki ka't bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu jodai' maa'n na ja'p.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu takarui' cham jabka' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jajar cham jabka' maa'n bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu chuukug gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu jodai' taxchaabgi'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar gu o'o baasɨ'n gu ux gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ jugi gu tanoolh ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' cham mi'x dhaas cham tu' na ba' gu tanoolh.
Gu' gu' tu' gu maa'nkar ka't gu tasi' gu kutun gu tanoolh gu jodai' gu maa'nkar ka't jugi; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu tanoolh buimgidhak.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ba' vaik gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu maa'nkar ka't gu chuukug gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' jugi gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu chuukug vaik gu tanoolh gu jodai' cham ka't gu ux tu' ka't gu suudai'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook jugi jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham jugi; gio ba' gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan; gu' no'x na jix bhai' jugi gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jugi gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios kua' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jugi gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaakax tu' mar kaneer tu' gu ñi'ook jugi.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix koi gu jodai' ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' na ba' no'x gu tasi' gu' cham jugi.
Na gu' na gu' no'x jugi gu jodai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jugi ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' matgɨm gu ɨ'ɨr jugi bɨx gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu noobh gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bɨɨx baaso; mi' dhɨr baaso na ba' gu ux ka't gu takarui' na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gu' baaso ka't gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu chuukug.
Na gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chuukug gu jodai' ka't gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim.

Na gu' na gu' jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu chuukug baaso gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu maa'nkar jix maa gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ux gu kutun gu Aaroon gu kutun gu ma'nkam baasɨ'n gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' na ba' gu suudai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga maa'nkar tai bhaan gu o'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu tanoolh jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun tuur gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Moisees gu chuukug gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr gu kutun jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tu jiim gu ux jix dhaas gu Urim gu Tummim.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu takarui' bhaan mo'o; gio ba' bhaan gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu takarui' abhaar; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun tu jiim vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx tu'x mi'p jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv mui'kim tu jiim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx gu ux gu bhóogɨt na ba' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun bhaan mo'o gu Aaroon tu jiim na ba' jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug tuur gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o tuur gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tasi'; gio ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bɨɨx gu chuukug bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr mi'x juu'ñ gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix bhaan duu na ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu jodai' ka't bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gook gu chuukug gu jodai' gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' gu' tuur gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tasi'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duu gu oi'ñga'n mo'o gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix dhaas gu noobh bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tasi'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ naak tu jiim gu Aaroon bhaan gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu jiim bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix dhaas gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Moisees gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu jodai' bɨx gu jodai' ka't bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gook gu chuukug gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' cham jabka' gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix dhaas bɨɨx gu jodai' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix dhaas bɨx gu noobh gu Aaroon gu noobh gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ mii' dhɨr tu'x gu Moisees gu noobh gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees baaso jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt ka't baasɨ'n gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bhaan gu Aaroon bhaan kutun bhaan gu ma'nkam bhaan kutun gu ma'nkam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhaan duu gu Aaroon kutun gu ma'nkam kutun gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jugi gu chuukug ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; mi' dhɨr jugi bɨɨx gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' bhaan tu' jix aa'ñdhix bham; jano' ba' gu Aaroon maraa'n jugi.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chuukug gu takarui' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu takarui'; na gu' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut no'm gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh nukadham jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' cham gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' jix duñia' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duu bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu Moisees jup tɨɨt gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam daraa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook tuur na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan cham gu jodai' gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ chiiw na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tuur mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham gu oi'ñga'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook na ba' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu o'o gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu takarui' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vupui gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ux tu' gu ux gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu vupui gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu ux; jano' ba' na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Aaroon jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu tasi' tuur gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon aichdhak gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ɨ'ɨr jix dhaas bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ja'aa gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr tɨɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu chuukug gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Gu' gu' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tai mai' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' xikoolh bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mi' dhɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook mo'o; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gio gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam jix bhɨɨ gu chio'ñ chiiw ka't na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu tasi' makgɨrxi gu ux uañi'ñ na ja'p maa'n.
Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu makgɨrxi gu suudai' gu o'o jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh.
Jano' ba' gu tasi' gio gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu chuukug ka't gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu vaakax; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨɨx jix duñia' ba'k gu chuukug gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu jodai' bhaan gu tasi' jix duñia' gu jodai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tasi' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu ux gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Aaroon gu noobh bhaan gu ja'tkam jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix dhaav bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' baap gu Moisees gu Aaroon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' moor jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu jodai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' ia'rɨ bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix bhɨɨ maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai bhaan jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tai gu tanoolh cham pai' dhuuk jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' dhi' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tas na jix gɨ'; jano' ba' gu Aaroon jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Moisees gu Misael gu Elsapaan gu ma'nkam gu Ussiel gu suudai' gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan xidhuu mai' yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi' na ja'p gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam; na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt ɨɨbhidham tu' gu takarui' jajannulhi'ñ na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' daak bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' koi; na gu' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duu jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon bham.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak cham i'i suudai' u'va tu' gu oi'ñga'n na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n baakɨi vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ux gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moisees.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam a'ga jix duñia'; na gu' jix bhɨɨ gu o'o gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jugi cham jabka' ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt abhaar.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi pai' jix bhaan; na gu' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' jix aa'ñdhix.

Na gu' jugi gu suudai' pai' na jix bhai' tu' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak baaso gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' na gu' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n na ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' gu jodai' jix duñia' jix duu gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu chuukug baaso ka't gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu chuukug gu ux gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ka't gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam bɨndak na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't gu chuukug; gio ba' bhaam bhaan gu Eleasar gu Itamar gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu suudai' jix duñia' bham.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook cham koi'mɨk gu ñi'ook pai' jix bhaan na gu' gu bhóogɨt abhaar jix maa gu ñi'ook na ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' ka't gu takarui' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix ai gu ɨ'ɨr cham ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' gu suudai' jugi pai' jix bhaan na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Aaroon gu Moisees; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x; na gu' tu' jugi tu' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees jix kai dhi' jix maa gu ux gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu vaakax jugi bɨx gu vaakax bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax bɨx gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jugi.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham gu ñi'ook cham jugi gu chuukug namki' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix ai na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' jix xoi'kam gu ux ñaanbi'.
Na gu' gio gu tasi' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gui'x gu ux ñaanbi'.
Na gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gui'x gu ux gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Na gu' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gui'x gu ux ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug cham jugi tu' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix koi; gio ba' gui'x gu ux jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' jugi bɨx tu'x gu suudai'; gio ba' bɨx tu'x namki' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr jugi.
Gu' gu' bɨx tu'x cham namki' gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' bɨx gu ko'oi gu suudai' na ja'p bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na jix do'ig gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug cham jugi jix duñia' gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' bɨx cham jix duñia' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gui'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu u'uvhig gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham jugi ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu chuukug bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu u'uuv gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bhaan na jax chu'm gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bhaan maakobh tɨɨt jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook dhi' jugi bɨx gu ko'oi gu oi'ñga'n jiim bhaan maakobh tɨɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨɨt na ba' gu ta'm na tu maakia' gu Dios bɨɨx bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jugi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan na jax chu'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan na jax chu'm gu jodai' bhaan na jax chu'm gu suudai' bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' maakobh tɨɨt jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' tu'x ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' no'x gu suudai' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook gu chuukug koko'kam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu' cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux ñaanbi'; gio ba' no'x gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu vaakax gu kutun maakobh tɨɨt jix duñia' gu ux ñaanbi' no'x gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chuukug; gio ba' no'x gu suudai' gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug koko'kam jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' jix duñia' jix xoi'kam gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ux jix bhai'x gu ko'oi gu takarui' gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu jodai' bhaan na jax chu'm.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu tasi' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ux jix bhai'x bɨx gu ko'oi; na pai' dhuuk no'x gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk koko'kam ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan jix duñia' oi'ñdha' mi' dhɨr koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu ux gu u'u na ja'p tɨi'chu' zel gu ux gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu jodai' gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oi'ñdha' bɨx ka't ñaanbi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu kutun jugi bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu takarui' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' ka't bɨx jix duñia' gu takarui' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr bhaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix koi ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx suudai' buusñi gu ja'tkam pai' gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' ka't dhaa gu chuukug koko'kam ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chuukug koko'kam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kai' ka't gu suudai' ka't na jix bhai'.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu kai' jix duñia' gu chuukug koko'kam bhaan gui'x gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' tu' gu kutun gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam na ba' jugi gu jodai' gu suudai' gu chuukug jix koi ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' jugi gu chuukug jix koi jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug jix koi jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ko'oi tu' gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham jugi.
Na gu' bɨx jiim bhaan baaso bɨx jiim bhaan maakobh gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨt bɨx gu ko'oi jiim gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha' cham jugi na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ko'oi gu chuukug gu ko' na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim tu' gu chuukug bɨɨx tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ux.

Na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ux gu jodai' jix bhaan ka't jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan; na ba' cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ko'oi gu ñi'ook ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' ka't jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' jix duñia' jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaakax gu u'uvhig bɨx gu suudai' na jix do'ig oidha' bhaan jiim gu suudai' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu chuukug ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu oidha'.
Na ba' na ba' gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñaanbi' na jix bhai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax jɨ'xdha' jugi gu vaakax cham jɨ'xdha' jugi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kɨɨv gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr jurtu'nka' gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu takarui' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu ɨ'ɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' matgɨm jix bhaan abhaar gu ñi'ook tu' ɨlhdham xidhuu bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' na ba' gu u'vɨ ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gook gu chuukug jurtu'nka' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ɨ'ɨr.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu mar gu ux mar u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt mar kaneer oi'ñga' na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux ka't na jix bhai' ɨ'ra'n gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu ñi'ook na ba' mar kaneer jix bhɨɨ jano' ba' gook gu ñi'ook gook gu ñi'ook maa'n na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux ka't na jix bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ jix duñia' zel gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu vaak gu suudai' ka't zel gu chuukug na ja'p tu jiim dua'ñdha' ka't gu jodai' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu jiim zel gu chuukug; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' tu jiim tu' gu bhóogɨt jix toja gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu suudai' gu chuukug tu jiim dua'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'.

Jano' ba' tu' zel gu chuukug ka't gu vaak gu suudai' gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix toja jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' tu jiim gu suudai' ka't dhi' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n jix vɨɨk; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x tu jiim cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr ka't gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu jodai' gu takarui' gu suudai' zel mi' dhɨr ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu suudai' na jix bhai' ka't buupui jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n zel jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; gio ba' dua'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't tu jiim dua'ñdha' gu chio'ñ ka't gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix toja zel ka't gu jodai' jix uam gu takarui' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu tai.
Jano' ba' dua'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel gu chuukug; na gu' maa'n gu ux ñaanbi' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham jix duñia' na gu' ñaanbi'.
Gu' gu' tu' jix buusñi dua'ñdha' gu jodai' gu ux gu takarui' bɨx zel gu chuukug dɨr mo'o bɨɨx ka'm tɨɨt bɨx ñiata gu vupui jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' dua'ñdha' ka't jix bhaan dhaas bɨx gu chuukug maa'n gu ux na jix bhai' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu suudai'; jano' ba'.
Gu' gu' gu tanoolh jix ñi'ñ gu chuukug gu tai ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug gu tai maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug gu tai; mi' dhɨr dua'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu tai gu suudai' jix duñia' gu suudai' jano' ba' ɨlhdham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu' tu jiim ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux na jix bhai' ga'ra' tu jiim ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug zel ka't gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' pai' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix toja gu vaak gu suudai' gu takarui' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix toja maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ux ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim dua'ñdha' jix duñia' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' jix toja tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jix duñia' gu ux zel jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; gio ba' tu jiim.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak gu suudai' pai' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux na jix bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jix duñia' zel gu tasi' gu tai ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix toja gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' zel dua'ñdha' jix buus gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ñaanbi' gu ux gu suudai' tu jiim dua'ñdha'.

Gu' gu' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu takarui' jix toja tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' ka't gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ux zel jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim dua'ñdha'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak pai' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; gio ba' maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ux na jix bhai'; na nɨi'ñchudat gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook tu jiim mo'o gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu takarui' mai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n dua'ñdha' mo'o gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' tu' ka't gu takarui' jix tuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' ka't gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhaan gu' cham bhaan pai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan juraa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ja'tkam jix duñia' zel mi' dhɨr gu duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel cham jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n ñaanbi'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix tuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na jix bhai' gu ux maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk zel gu chuukug jix duñia' gu vaak chooto.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' zel gu chuukug gu vaak chooto gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ jix buusñi zel na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' mo'o jix bhai'x gu' na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' baasɨ'n gu vupui gu takarui' mo'o jix bhai'x gu ux vupui bhaan gu' na jix bhai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk gu duukam gu bhóogɨt ka't tu jiim gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt dua'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu duukam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu duukam gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu suudai' dua'ñdha' gu suudai' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gakiidha' ñaanbi'; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan maa'n gu ux ñaanbi'; mi' dhɨr mo'o juraa'n tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gakiidha' ka't tu jiim jajannulhi'ñ ka't gu chuukug mo'o gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gio ba' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook tu jiim ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix daa gu duukam; jano' ba' mai' vaak ja'tkam ka't jix koi.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tɨi'chu' ka't gu ux dua'ñdha' tɨi'chu' gu ja'tkam tɨi'chu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam zel no'x gu ñi'ook zel.
Jano' ba' gu ux ka't gu vaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨi'chu' zel dhi' gu duukam no'x tu duukam zel; gio ba' gu ux dua'ñdha' tu' gu takarui' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu ux jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ux; gio ba' tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tɨi'chu' dhi' gu duukam zel no'x gu ñi'ook duñia' tɨɨt dua'ñdha' jix duñia' gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chuukug tɨi'chu' dhi' gu duukam gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'x tu duukam tɨɨt ka't jix duñia' gu ux; na gu' dua'ñdha' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tai ka't vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x tu duukam tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a pai' gu ux jix duñia' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' mi' dhɨr gu ux ka't gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux cham tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu ñi'ook gu tai; jano' ba' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu' jix bhai'x mi' dhɨr ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨi'chu' zel dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix ñi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n tɨi'chu' dhi' gu ñi'ook no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu tai mii' dhɨr pai' gu ux.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨi'chu' dhi' gu duukam no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duñia' gookim jix duñia' jano' ba' ka't na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ux dua'ñdha' tɨi'chu' gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu duukam no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ zel na ba' ka't gu jodai' gu ux na jix bhai' gu ux gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ka't ñi'ook na tu a'ga gakiidha' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' mai' vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ñɨi'ñ jix duñia' gu ux dua'ñdha' gakiidha'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu suudai' gook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
