Jano' ba' bɨɨx dhi' jix duñia' gu Aaroon xidhuu; gio ba' bɨɨx tuur gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook abhaar gu ux gu ñi'ook bhaan gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu ux; gio ba' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ux gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' kutun; jano' ba' bɨɨx mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gook gu oi'ñga'n chiiw na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Aaroon tuur gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gook gu vupui chiiw jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk gu Aaroon bhaan gook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Aaroon gu chio'ñ chiiw bhaan jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ gu takarui' bhaan jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bhaan na ba' tɨip gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Aaroon tuur ka't gu kutun na ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak gu tasi' gu ñi'ook tuur gu kutun.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ vaak na jix bhaan jix bhuup gu takarui' gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios toov gu ñi'ook iiñat bhaan chuut cham koi.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur jix duñia' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bhaan iiñat gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai'; gio ba' bhaan iiñat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv mui'kim mii' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tasi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ chiiw ka't gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr na ja'p jix duu gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan iiñat vupui bhaan iiñat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' xidhuu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bɨx uañi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' gio vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook xidhuu bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu vaak gu ux bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ɨ'ɨr tuur gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw gu bhóogɨt bhaan a'aa' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨv mui'kim jix duñia' jix bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook xidhuu vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu oi'ñga'n bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx uañi'ñ gu suudai' bhaan mo'o gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix bhai'x gu novɨ gu chio'ñ gu suudai' na ba' dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ chiiw jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu takarui'; gio ba' kiicha' tu' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ɨlhdham gu Aaroon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham kutun gu bhóogɨt gu ux ka't tɨi'chu' na ba' baakɨi xidhuu gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' pai' xidhuu mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu jodai' jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't baabuk gu chio'ñ gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio bɨɨx gu suudai' gu chuukug mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' mai' vaak ja'tkam tuur uañi'ñ gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu chuukug na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook xidhuu; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tai gu chuukug gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug; gio ba' gu takarui' kɨɨv mambhɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' gu chuukug tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' dhi' gu tanoolh jix duñia' na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't gu suudai' bɨx uañi'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Saabado jɨɨpi'ñka' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't maa'n gu novɨ ka't jix duñia' jix bhuup na ba' gu suudai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan pai' gu taat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ux kutun gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xidhuu jix bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ja'tkam gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx uañi'ñ jix duñia' oi'ñga'; gio ba' gu Moisees jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' dhi' tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu tasi' gu vaakax mar kaneer gu ñi'ook vaak ja'tkam mai' vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ja'aa; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan gu vupui yooxi' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na jix bhai' makgɨrxi'ñdha' i'ii'mda' bhaan jix duñia'; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu ux ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' daipu' gio; gio ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu chio'ñ ka't gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook jugi gu ɨ'ɨr gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu oidha' gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' tu' jix maa na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jugi gu ɨ'ɨr tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jugi gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu u'uvhig ka't jugi gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Na gu' na gu' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' cham jugi gu ɨ'ɨr matgɨm gu chuukug na gu' gu oidha' bɨx gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr; jano' ba' no'x jugi ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook jix koi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ja'p xoi'kam gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix koi; gio ba' tu' jix duu na ja'p xoi'kam gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr tu' jiim ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux tu duukam ñi'ook kavɨk nukadham jiim; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' nukadham duñia' gu chio'ñ ii'mdagaram; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt matgɨm mia'n gu chuukug na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat gu ñi'ook gu naan cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu naan cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan jix duñia' gu vaak jix duñia' mai' gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu mar mar u'vɨ gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu u'vɨ gu taat gu oi'ñga'n gu taat gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu chuukug gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu naan cham gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu chuukug gu naan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu u'vɨ gu mar; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ xibhɨk cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham jix bhɨɨ mar u'vɨ gu mar tu' mar u'vɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu u'vɨ tɨtmo gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug gu kai' na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tai gu Molok; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham tu' mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx gu chio'ñ na ja'p bɨɨx gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaakax gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx; gio ba' tu' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu vaakax na ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' matgɨm dhi' tu'x jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia' gu suudai' chɨbɨɨp tu' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' tu' na cham jir bhai' bhaan gu oidha' jix duñia' jix koi.
Jano' ba' nukadham gu takarui' ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' cham xoi'kam matgɨm bɨx dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu gu chichio'ñ gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu va'k gu takarui' gu oidha' ka't jix duñia'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu ux jix duñia' gu takarui' na ja'p jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ka't va'k gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨx dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam ka't gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' nukadham jir bɨx bhai' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n chooto'n pai' va'k gu takarui' cham gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na gu' jɨɨgi'ñdham ka't na gu' jix bhaan jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu naan gu taat tas na jix bhaan nukadham; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix maat duiñxim tu' jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios aagak gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't jugi gu tanoolh gu jodai' buimgidhak gu tanoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' vaik gu tanoolh ka't gu chuukug gu tai.
Jano' ba' tu' jugi gu tanoolh vaik ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham ka't gu ux.
Na gu' jugi jix duñia' gu suudai' na gu' jix duñia' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham gu suudai' oidha' u'va tu' gu suudai' vaak na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va; na ba' gampai' na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr kiicha'; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' cham jix duñia' tu' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtmo tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' cham gu jodai' tu jiim gu chuukug gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x vupui bhaan bai'ñchu' cham gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu' gu oi'ñga'n choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gampai' tu' nɨidhat gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx bɨx bhai' gu bhóogɨt tɨtmo.
Jano' ba' cham gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu ɨ'ɨr tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n xibhɨk gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu suudai' tɨtmo cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨtmo na ja'p tu'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk nukadham; gio ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n cham jix duu gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug cham gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kai' cham tu' gu bhóogɨt jajannulhi'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai' ɇɇka' tu'x.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ka't ja'tkam na tu juan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx oi'ñdha' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook ka't gɨɨ'bia'; na gu' cham koi na gu' cham namkidhat.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux uañi'ñ jugi; gio ba' uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu' jugi.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu ux vaas bɨx gu u'u jugi jix duñia' maa'n gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' vaik gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu i'bhɨ cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' bɨx gu i'bhɨ ka't jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' jixchamaam oi'ñga' jugi gu i'bhɨ na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' cham ka't gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ɨɨbhidham tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ux jix koi tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham gu chuukug gu oidha' gu suudai' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tas na jix bhaan nukadham xidhuu jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' cham gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu jodai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n nɨidhat gu vupui jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n choo'n; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ja'tkam mii' dhɨr jix koi bɨndak gu oidha' cham gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu jodai' na ja'p tu'; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham xoi'kam gu i'ii'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' gu Epa jir bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jir bhai' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu duukam; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' daipu' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Israeel jix maa gu kai' gu Molok gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix maa gu kai' gu Molok gu oi'ñga'n xidhuu gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na tu' gu takarui' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu vupui mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't jix maa gu kai' gu Molok na ba' cham mu'aa'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bhaan ja'tkam vaak gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨɨx bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Molok.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' na ba' gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui bhaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu naan tɨɨda' koi; gio ba' gu taat gu naan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jugi jix duñia' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ tɨtmo jix bhai'x jix duñia' koi gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' no'x mi'x juu'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu taat gu ñi'ook gu taat jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' koko'kam; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' koi; gio ba' jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' no'x jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu chio'ñ na ja'p bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duu; gio ba' ba'k jix duñia' gu suudai' koko'kam; mi' dhɨr bhaan ka't gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu naan jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tai na gu' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' no'x jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax tu' gu suudai' jix koi; gio ba' yaa' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt gu kutun gu vaakax na ba' mambhɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu vaakax koo'nda'; gio ba' koi jix bhai'x; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.

Jano' ba' no'x jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam mar u'vɨ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu naan gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai'x; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ka't koko'kam gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' uañi'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook suudai' buusñi jix ñi'ñ suudai' buusñi gu ɨ'ɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu naan gu ja'tkam gu taat cham gu bhóogɨt; na gu' jix ñi'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu taat gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu taat jix ñi'ñ; gio ba' uañi'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr koi cham gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ xibhɨk gu ux; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xibhɨk jix ñi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham gu ma'nkam ka't.
Jano' ba' nukadham bɨx ñi'ook kavɨk bɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam tu' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu takarui'; na gu' jix duu bɨx dhi' tu'x jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu' gu suudai' na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ux gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n na jix bhai' ñaanbi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'uvhig gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; gio ba' cham gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu vaakax tu' gu u'uvhig tu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' ko'oi na oi'ñga'n chɨt tu jiim gu ux gu oidha' gu vaak gu ux jix bhai'x.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug jɨɨgi'ñdham na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix bhaan gu vaak gu ja'tkam na ba' ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu chuukug gu suudai' jix duñia' gu suudai' koko'kam; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu jodai; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu takarui' cham gu chuukug gu ux jix koi gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu ux jir bɨx bhai' mia'n gu ux gu naan gu ux gu taat gu ux gu mar gu ux xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mia'n cham ka't jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu ux jix duñia'.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' na gu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu jodai' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu i'ii'ñ mo'o tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug tu' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jɨɨgi'ñdham ka't gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' ka't jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ganai' gu ñi'ook cham jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' tu' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ; na gu' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug; na gu' jix bhaan ka't na ba' tu' na gu' jix bhaan jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mar u'vɨ gu chio'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jugi gu oi'ñga'n gu taat gu takarui'; gio ba' vaak na jix bhaan ka't gu tai.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bhaan mo'o ka't vaak na jix bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun jix duñia' gu novɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook mo'o tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' pai' ka't gu ñi'ook muukix tu' gu ux gu taat gu ux gu naan jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' xidhuu tu' jix duñia' xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' kuruun bɨ'ñdhatu' gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook ganai' gu suudai' cham jix bhɨɨ; gu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu kai' gu ja'tkam; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu ma'nkam ka't uañi'ñ cham jix duñia' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ ka't uañi'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chio'ñ bai'ñchu' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't gu chuukug tɨɨt gu chuukug gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x jix duñia' toov gu vupui jix duñia' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ jugi gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't uañi'ñ jix duñia' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan tu'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jugi.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ; na gu' cham jix duñia' xidhuu na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees dhi' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu suudai' jix bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu takarui'; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ bɨx gu kai' gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'x gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios da'p gu vaak bhaan vupui bhaan tu' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu kai' gu Aaroon ka't gakiidha' gu ñi'ook ɨ'ra'n cham jugi tu'x gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu suudai' no'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix koi gu chio'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu kai'.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't dhaa gu chuukug gu ko'oi gu ux ka't ñaanbi' gu chio'ñ gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' ñaanbi' jurtu'nka' no'x gu vaak gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai cham jugi tu'x gu jodai' va'k ka't tooton gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas jix duñia' ka't na jix bhai'; na gu' mi' dhɨr jugi tu'x gu jodai' na gu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koi tu' gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt cham jugi na ba' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk nukadham jir bɨx bhai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ uañi'ñ gu ux gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' onbai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu chuukug cham jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk jugi gu ñi'ook tuumiñ gu chuukug jugi maaxir gu vaak; gio ba' suulhgia' jugi gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu tanoolh cham jugi gu maa'nkar tu'x gu jodai'.

Gu' gu' tu' mar u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu bhóogɨt cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu taat na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu taat; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu vaak jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam maa'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhai'x na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu gu suudai' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jugi tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu chio'ñ gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu ux bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bɨx gu chuukug gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' aagak gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ cham gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaneer tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't uañi'ñ gu bhóogɨt na gu' cham ka't gu ux gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak ka't gu jodai' kakneer cham gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ux; gio ba' cham tu' gu suudai' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bai'ñchu' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x cham gu bhóogɨt suulhgia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu maa'nkar gu takarui'; gu' gu ux gu tasi' cham ka't gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oidha' jix duu.
Jano' ba' gu novɨ gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx dhi' tu'x; na gu' ja'bsuna'; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch uañi'ñ cham jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Na pai' dhuuk gu vaakax mar kaneer gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu suudai' gu naan; gu' dɨr jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't gu ux na ba' gu maa'nkar gu tai gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't gu vaakax gu ñi'ook cham gu tasi' gu tanoolh gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' gu maa'nkar taxchaabgidhat taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios aagak gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jugi; gio ba' cham mi'x dhaas na ba' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu chuukug jix bhaan gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Na gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tanoolh jix duñia' kɨɨv gu tanoolh juanda' jɨɨpi'ñka' ka't gu ñi'ook abhaar; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook jix duu; mi' dhɨr juanda' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook xib ja'k tɨkɨr gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh dhi' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jugi gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tanoolh jix duñia' abhaar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dharka' gu i'bhɨ oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham gu jodai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu o'o ka't gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham jugi gu takarui' tu' kai'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug gu ux gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook dɨr buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' dɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu suudai'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm buimgidhak gu tanoolh juanda' kɨɨv gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tanoolh; gio ba' jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix vɨɨk gu o'o gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gook gu takarui' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu suudai' ka't gook gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu jodai' bɨɨx jabka' gu ux gu ux na tu ibai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu takarui' kɨɨv gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' cham gu jodai' tuur gu ñi'ook gook gu chuukug; gio ba' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gook gu ja'tkam oi'ñga' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ gu maa'nkar gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu takarui' gu ux na tu ibai' gook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu tanoolh; gio ba' ka't abhaar gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu; jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gu chuukug bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu bhóogɨt.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt oraa'; na ba' gampai' na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr kiicha'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' kɨɨv maa'n gu takarui' jix duñia' juanda' gu ñi'ook kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk abhaar gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix duu; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu chio'ñ gu takarui' koi'm no'x gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n koi'm.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax ka't gu oidha' ka't bɨx gu i'bhɨ na ba' jugi.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan oi'ñga' mambhɨɨx jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' bɨx jix koi; gio ba' gu ux ka't gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook maa'n gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak.

Jano' ba' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨtmo; gu' gu oi'ñga'n choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ñi'ook kavɨk nukadham gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux tu duukam jix daa gu oidha' gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x na gu' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu takarui' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' bɨx gu oidha' gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu kutun gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar ɨlhdham gu ñi'ook mia'n jix duñia' xibhɨk ka't jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ jix duñia' na ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' jugi bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak jix koi kiicham mia'n gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' u'ua'tɨda' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' oi'ñga' ka't gu oidha' jix bhaai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook oi'ñga' gu takarui' gu vaak kiicham vaak jodai jix duñia' na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ux mii' dhɨr jugi na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' tu duukam na ja'p gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't chɨbɨɨp xikoolh; gio ba' jugi tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gio jugi gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ba' gu ma'nkam mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu maa'nkar gu jodai'; na ba' bɨɨx tas tu juan; gu' cham gu ñi'ook xibhɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix duñia' maa'n bhaan xibhɨk bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨndak gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt xibhɨk bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨndak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam mii' dhɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' gu kutun gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' maa'n xibhɨk gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu mar gu suudai' jix duñia' mia'n gu chuukug gu ma'nkam jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jugi dɨr oi'ñga' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu jodai'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt tuumiñ gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' ka't mui'x gu takarui' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu kutun tuumiñ gu ux jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu jodai' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu kutun jurtu'nka' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x jix duñia' bɨɨx; gio ba' cham jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu jodai' jix duñia' gu takarui' oi'ñga' gu jodai' gu ma'nkam bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' tu duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu duukam gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham jix duu na ba' gu ñi'ook duiñxim tu' gu vaak tu' jix búup dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu jodai gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ux; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' nukadham tas na jix bhaan gu ja'tkam tu jiim xidhuu; gio ba' gu Yo gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun nukadham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux tu duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u yooxi' maa'n gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu chuukug jugi gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt jix daa gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu oidha' jix koox cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook obhɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook chamaam gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' obhɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu jodai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx bhaan.
Jano' ba' jugi gu suudai' jix jai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mai' gu suudai' kuiñcha jix vɨɨk.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n tu duukam; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu tasi' gu ñi'ook jiim gu vupui jix bhai'x.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' xoi'kam bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Yo gio gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu vupui gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu kai' na gu' obhɨɨ'ñ jugi.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt daak bhaan gu ñi'ook ka't gu chuukug vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' bɨɨx jix duñia' tu'x cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨɨv mui'kim gu oi'ñga'n gu ux uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu tɨkɨr na ja'p jix kavɨk jodai gu oidha' na ja'p gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu oidha' cham maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu u'u gu oidha' cham jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n cham gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook kɨɨv mui'kim gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gio bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaakax gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu vaakax gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt ka't oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' tu'x cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' kɨɨv mui'kim gu ux uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kuchii gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh; gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk tu' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jugi cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx dhi' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak gu jodai' gu suudai' kɨɨv mui'kim gu ux uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jugi gu chuukug gu ma'nkam jugi gu chuukug ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug koko'kam bhaan gu chuukug koko'kam duiñxim gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh oidha' jix gaki gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gio gu oidha' jix duñia' obhɨɨ'ñ jix koi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ux chɨbɨɨp gu chuukug gu kuchii gu ñi'ook mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu takarui' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' tas na jix bhaan bɨx gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' pai' jix duñia' jano' ba' jix duñia' tas na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu takarui' jix duñia' cham jix duñia' tas na jix bhaan gu bhóogɨt oi'ñka'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jajar gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu chuukug cham soo'mchulhdhak gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p tu' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ux soo'mchulhdhak gu suudai'; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' oi'ñga'n obhɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tattat gu takarui' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tattat gu ux jix duñia' bɨɨx jix duñia' bhaan tu'; na gu' gio na gu' jix duñia' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Jakob gu suudai' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Isaak gio ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Abraam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt chɨ'ñchoka' gu oidha'.

Na gu oidha' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' tas na jix bhaan kua' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha; gu' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook sɨlhka'n gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu suudai' ñi'ook kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' bɨɨx bɨx dhi' kua' gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ tu' cham gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk va'k gu ñi'ook gu ux ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhai'x na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu vupui chɨbɨɨp na ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Sinaii gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai bhaan gu bhóogɨt xidhuu.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu u'vɨ gu jodai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't jixchamaam gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ka't gu takarui' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu u'vɨ mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm jixchamaam gu takarui' gu jodai' ka't gu vaak gu chio'ñ jixchamaam gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu ux gu u'vɨ ka't gu jodai' vaik gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix gu ux gu chio'ñ gu jodai' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu u'vɨ mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt.

Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gampai' gu jodai' jano' ba' jugi vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu vaakax gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jix maa gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu jodai' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam jix bhai' gu ux cham bhai' tu' cham bhai' gu ux jix bhai'; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu vaakax gu ux jix maa gu ux gu takarui' ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't gu kutun gu vaakax ñaanbi' cham gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios jano' ba' gu vaakax ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' ka't jix bhai' ka't cham bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' gu jodai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim gu ñi'ook jixchamaam bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jix bhai' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook jixchamaam tuumiñ ka't gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' ka't jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' dɨr oi'ñga' gu jodai' jurtu'nka' gu jodai' jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' mi' dhɨr gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' tuumiñ jurtu'nka' gu takarui' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' jix bhaan duu gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jixchamaam tuumiñ jix duñia' na ba'.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu jodai' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham tu jiim gu oi'ñga'n.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu oidha' ka't abhaar gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu oidha' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñga' gu jodai' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh maa'n nɨi'ñchudat u'uuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt jugi gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu chuukug ka't jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt xidhuu; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt juraa'n gu ñi'ook gu vaak.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar gu vaakax gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios soo'mchulhdhak jix bhaan; gio ba' ka't gu vaakax kaneer gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' ka't gu vaakax jix bhai'x tu jiim jurtu'nka' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bhaan jixchamaam; gio ba' tu' cham gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu jodai'.

Gu' gu' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' oi'ñdha' ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar cham gu ñi'ook tu' tu jiim; gio ba' bɨx jix bhaan ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' cham ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' gu suudai' jix koi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu kai' gu oidha' na ja'p gu i'bhɨ gu u'u gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu bhóogɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' kakneer bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham tu jiim tu' jix bhai' cham bhai' tu' jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't tu'x gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr cham tu jiim.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
